# Words at Rest

> Words at Rest (https://wordsatrest.com) is a free, independent website of calm English (en-US) word search puzzles for adults and seniors. Edited by Reggie J. Contact: hello@wordsatrest.com.

Key facts:
- Launched 2026-10-06. 116 themes, 828 hand-themed puzzles, plus one unique daily puzzle per day from 2026-10-07 (UTC midnight; /daily/YYYY-MM-DD; /calendar).
- Easy 10×10/10 · Medium 12×12/14 · Hard 15×15/18 · Large print 9×9/8. Original word lists; no licensed characters.
- No medical or brain-training claims.
